ideas.title: 4 Bedroom Luxury Industrial Villa
highlights: Private pool, hot tub and BBQ area
Pool table, arcade machine and board games
Concrete industrial fit-out with a big open-plan living room
ideas.notes: Available for our dates (checked 22 Nov). Host Eka averages 4.33★ over 18 reviews on his other places. The header says 4 bedrooms but the description mentions more, so worth asking. No smoke or CO alarm listed.

ideas.title: Sunset View: Chic 4BR Villa
highlights: Private pool
Outdoor kitchen with grill
Daily housekeeping
ideas.notes: Still booked out 31 Dec and 1 Jan (checked 22 Nov), so we'd need somewhere else for New Year's Eve. Free 2–5 Jan. Run by Balinest Villas, a big Superhost manager. Dalung is a bit inland from central Canggu.
ideas.unavailable: Only free 2–5 Jan, 3 of our 5 Canggu nights

ideas.title: Seaside Luxury 4BR Villa, 400m to Finns
highlights: Private pool with sun beds
Outdoor lounge and tropical garden
Walk to Finns and the beach
ideas.notes: Available for our dates (checked 22 Nov). Superhost Rachel, 10 years hosting. Price includes a 10% early booking discount. The listing mentions a discount because of construction nearby, so expect some daytime noise.
ideas.cancel: Free cancellation for 24 hours after booking, partial refund before 24 Dec

ideas.title: MODJO Villas Bingin
ideas.location: Bingin, about a 6 min walk to Bingin Beach
highlights: Private pool with garden and pool views
Sunken lounge and open-plan living
Outdoor bathrooms with stone baths
Short walk to Bingin Beach, cafés and Alchemy
ideas.notes: Available for our dates but only 1 left (checked 22 Nov). $5,074 total for 5 adults from the Booking.com app, including parking and fast Wi-Fi. That rate is non-refundable. Rated 9.2 from 101 reviews, the best-reviewed option in Uluwatu so far.

ideas.title: Castle Lunita: Ocean View, Cinema & Gym
ideas.location: Clifftop Uluwatu, 10 min walk to Blue Point and Suluban beaches
highlights: Private pool, sauna, cinema room and home gym
Panoramic Indian Ocean views
Outdoor kitchen with grill
Every bedroom has its own bathroom
ideas.notes: Available for our dates (checked 22 Nov). Price is for 5 guests including taxes; it's $5,745 before tax. Superhost Edo, very responsive. Road construction down the valley until Dec 2026, usually quiet on the villa side.

ideas.title: Alex Villas: 3BR Pool Villa (AV5 or AV7)
ideas.location: Berawa, Canggu, 8 min walk to Berawa Beach
highlights: Private pool with sun loungers and garden
Balconies with pool views, daily housekeeping
Double-height open-plan living and dining
ideas.notes: The AV1 you sent is only 2 bedrooms, so I've swapped to the 3-bedroom villas in the same complex (1 of each left). With 5 of us, two people would share. Photos are from the complex. Price is a 62% off Black Friday deal and includes taxes.
ideas.cancel: Free cancellation before 10 Dec ($3,188 if non-refundable)

ideas.title: New 5BR Villa, 200m to the Beach
ideas.location: Seseh, just west of Pererenan, 4 min walk to Seseh Beach
highlights: Private pool and tropical garden
Every bedroom has its own bathroom
Fast Wi-Fi, about 100 Mbps
Part of a new complex of 6 villas
Walk to St. Ali and Pererenan cafés
ideas.notes: Available for our dates (checked 22 Nov). Everyone gets their own room. Price includes taxes with a 15% Late Escape deal, but it's non-refundable. Location rated lower (7.5) as it's further out than central Canggu.

ideas.title: Gracie Casa Villa, Bingin Beach
highlights: Private pool with outdoor shower
3 bedrooms plus a mezzanine with 2 single beds
Near Bingin Beach
ideas.notes: Available for our dates (checked 22 Nov). Cheapest option so far. The 4th 'bedroom' is a mezzanine with 2 singles, and there are only 3 bathrooms for 5 of us. Superhost Junita. Price includes a 10% discount.

ideas.title: Ocean Forest Villa, Bingin
ideas.location: Uluwatu-Bingin, 1.5 km to Padang Padang, 2 km to Bingin Beach
highlights: Private skate bowl and basketball court
Long pool and tropical garden with ocean and forest views
Full-time staff, daily cleaning and fast Wi-Fi
Optional private feast with catering and live music
ideas.notes: Available for our dates (checked 22 Nov). Big discount on now ($6,494 down to $3,720). Superhost Yohana, 3 years hosting. Free cancellation right up to 21 Dec.
